decisions.rationale: Duchenne muscular dystrophy is a single, specific disease with a defined definition and no further categorization, so it is annotated as a Specific Disease using the minimum full span.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 1 (Specific Disease); What to Annotate 5 (minimum necessary span)

decisions.rationale: DMD is the abbreviation defining Duchenne muscular dystrophy. Abbreviations are annotated as a separate mention from the long form, and here it refers to the same specific disease.
DMD refers to the specific disease Duchenne muscular dystrophy in the context of the five boys studied, so it is annotated as a Specific Disease.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 1 (Specific Disease); What to Annotate 4 (duplicate mentions)

decisions.rationale: DMD here names the disease itself (an animal model for DMD), referring to the specific disease Duchenne muscular dystrophy rather than an organism.
The mdx mouse is an animal model and organism strain, not a disease mention. Organism and model names are not annotated unless the disease they cause is the subject, which is not the case here.
DMD refers to the specific disease in the context of the five boys with DMD whose ERGs were recorded, so it is annotated as a Specific Disease.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 1 (Specific Disease); What to Annotate 4 (duplicate mentions)

decisions.rationale: mdx here designates a mouse strain used as an animal model (anesthetized mdx mice), not a human disease. Organism and strain names are excluded from annotation.
mdx refers to the mouse strain (mdx mice) and not to a disease. Organism names are not annotated unless the disease they cause is being discussed.
DMD is named as the disease manifestation (a manifestation of DMD associated with dystrophin gene defects), referring to the specific disease Duchenne muscular dystrophy.
The mdx mouse is an animal model/organism, and the sentence is about the mouse ERG, not a disease. Organism names are not annotated.
DMD is named as the disease for which the ERG may serve as a diagnostic tool, referring to Duchenne muscular dystrophy as a specific disease.

milder allelic forms of DMD refers to a family of multiple related variant diseases (allelic dystrophinopathies), which is not a single specific disease. This is a grey-area term that may be annotated as a Disease Class, though it is borderline because 'forms' is generic.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 1 (Disease Class); Annotation Guidelines Examples 11 (grey area terms)
